name: Thruxton Circuit
description: A Hampshire airfield circuit and the fastest in the UK. Long, flat-out sweeps like Church, then the Complex and the chicane before the line.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (0 of 1506 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
